semantics: Public (static + instance) method declarations of StreamLogStore and StreamSnapshotStore, per issue #9590 Stage 5 (proof obligation 10). Every listed method is a caller-verified operation: transcript row mutation is writer-only (TranscriptWriter via acquireWriter/loadAndAcquireWriter), and snapshot event projection enters only through attachSessionEvents. The ratchet fails only when a store's public method count exceeds this baseline; 'protected' counts as public (neither class is subclassed, so protected would be a visibility trick, not encapsulation); counting is caller-honest — hiding equivalent operations behind params objects, aggregate getters, ports, or facades is not a reduction. When the surface genuinely shrinks (e.g. Stage 6 description-authority migration, Stage 7 legacy retirement), lower this baseline in the same PR.
